summary: Frontend-only regression for Phase 6 sidebar restyle + brand wordmark rollout. Tested at 1440 and 768 viewports with mock admin ava@goorin.com. Sidebar collapsed/expanded states, active indicator, hover+focus tooltips, needs-human badge, collapse toggle aria, agent role Settings gating, horizontal overflow at 768 (dashboard/inbox/guidance/settings/widget), login error, wordmark on login/widget-demo/survey/widget shadow DOM/theme-editor/settings-widget preview, favicon, JRN-10 wordmark→/dashboard, primary color controls. All critical behaviours PASS. Invite flow URLs could not be re-verified due to Cloudflare bot challenge triggering after many sequential navigations, but iteration_5 already covered them.
verified_items: nav-dashboard/inbox/guidance/settings each becomes data-active=true with aria-current=page and renders [data-testid=nav-active-indicator] (3x20px bar vertically centered at x=-0.5 along the sidebar left edge, NOT top-left)
nav-tooltip-<id> appears on both hover (visible=true) and keyboard focus with side='right'
sidebar-collapse-toggle has aria-label 'Expand sidebar'/'Collapse sidebar' and aria-expanded flips correctly when toggled
Expanded sidebar at 1440 shows sidebar-logo-tile + wordmark + 'Support Desk' label; Inbox count visible to the right
JRN-10: wordmark element is an <a href=/dashboard>
No horizontal overflow at 768 on /dashboard, /inbox, /guidance, /settings/widget (scrollWidth === clientWidth)
Login card renders Goorin wordmark img (src=/images/brand/goorin-wordmark-black.svg, alt='Goorin Bros.')
View as Agent hides nav-settings; /settings shows 'You don't have access to Settings' message
Chat widget inside shadow DOM exposes [data-testid=widget-logo] = goorin-wordmark-cream.svg (alt 'Goorin Bros. logo')
/survey/tok_GB1066 header uses goorin-wordmark-cream.svg over dark/espresso bg (castle+GOORIN wordmark)
/settings/widget live preview includes wordmark-cream header; 9 images including wordmark-black (sidebar), wordmark-cream (preview header/launcher) and ai-avatar; no castle crest PNGs

Primary color controls present with testids ws-color-primary, ws-primary-picker, ws-primary-hex and 10 presets (tobacco, espresso, brass, saddle, sage, oxblood, charcoal, cream, white). Changing color via color input works without error
notes: Login card wordmark element is a plain and does NOT carry data-testid='wordmark' (unlike the sidebar instance). JRN-10 requirement is that the WORDMARK links to /dashboard — this is satisfied by the sidebar wordmark () which is the only clickable brand mark inside the authed shell. The login card wordmark is intentionally not a link (pre-auth). If the product spec expects data-testid='wordmark' on the login img too, consider adding it for consistency, but it is not functionally a bug.
Hover tooltip test required ~1s delay after mouse.move before DOM reflects the tooltip; initial 400ms wait returned false. Keyboard-focus tooltip appears immediately.

After ~6-8 rapid navigations the preview domain starts returning a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' interstitial, which prevents further automated testing until the challenge clears. This is infra, not an app bug. Invite flows (/login?invite=demo-invite, /login?invite=expired) and dashboard KPI/CSAT testids therefore could not be re-verified in this iteration, but were green in iteration_5.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: consider adding data-testid='wordmark' to the login card for symmetry with other wordmark instances; makes automated brand audits simpler.
Minor DX: nav tooltip delay is noticeable in testing (hover needs ~800-1000ms before DOM mounts). If this is Radix Tooltip default (700ms), acceptable; just note for future a11y audits.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested items (invite flows not re-tested due to CF rate-limit)

test_credentials: ava@goorin.com / goorin123 (mock admin); error@goorin.com for error path
seed_data_creation: None (mocked data layer, resets on reload by design)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mock auth with sessionStorage; after ~8 nav() calls Cloudflare bot challenge may appear and block subsequent fills. Prefer fewer cross-page navigations per playwright session, or distribute across multiple browser_automation calls. Important testids: sidebar (data-collapsed), sidebar-logo-tile, wordmark (sidebar), nav-dashboard/inbox/guidance/settings (data-active, aria-current), nav-active-indicator, nav-tooltip-<id>, inbox-needs-human-badge, sidebar-collapse-toggle (aria-expanded), user-menu-trigger, role-toggle-admin/agent, widget-logo (inside shadow DOM), ws-color-primary, ws-primary-preset-*.
